responsibility: This file implements the runtime result object returned by in-memory libgccjit compilation. It wraps the loaded shared object handle produced by compilation, takes ownership of any deferred tempdir cleanup, unloads the DSO in its destructor, and resolves generated function or global symbols by name using dlsym or GetProcAddress. Its role is post-compilation code/global lookup and lifetime management for compiled results.
same_name_distinction: Implements the runtime behavior of gcc::jit::result declared in jit-result.h: unloading the loaded DSO, deleting any deferred tempdir, and resolving generated symbols with dlsym or GetProcAddress. Unlike the header, this .cc file contains the platform-specific post-compilation lookup and cleanup code.
